criteria.description: Document benchmark purpose, methodology, presets, interpretation, and current limitations.
criteria.evidence: docs/performance.md documents benchmark purpose, local-smoke and acceptance-smoke commands, JSON/text output fields, metric inventory, interpretation guidance, limitations, and warn-only baseline policy.

criteria.description: Preserve human-readable benchmark output while adding structured JSON output.
criteria.evidence: src/cli/benchmark.zig preserves text rendering and adds --format json; src/cli/benchmark_metrics.zig renders text and JSON reports; tests/integration/benchmark_output_acceptance.zig validates both output shapes.
criteria.notes: Validated by zig build test and local-smoke text output.

criteria.description: Add local-smoke and acceptance-smoke benchmark presets with documented counts.
criteria.evidence: zig build run -- benchmark --preset local-smoke passed; zig build run -- benchmark --preset acceptance-smoke --format json passed; docs/performance-baselines.json records expected preset metric counts.
criteria.notes: acceptance-smoke JSON reported rows=2000, vectors=512, dimensions=32, operations=200.

criteria.description: Report allocation counts and bytes for benchmarked workloads using explicit allocator instrumentation.
criteria.evidence: src/cli/benchmark_metrics.zig implements CountingAllocator and AllocationStats; benchmark text and JSON include allocation_count and allocation_bytes; tests/integration/benchmark_output_acceptance.zig validates allocation fields.
criteria.notes: local-smoke and acceptance-smoke JSON checks required allocation fields on every metric.

criteria.description: Add a point-lookup metric distinct from full table scans.
criteria.evidence: src/cli/benchmark.zig emits point_lookup; local-smoke text output included point_lookup; acceptance-smoke JSON count check validated point_lookup count 200.

criteria.description: Add or refine hybrid filter/vector ranking that combines metadata filtering and vector distance ordering.
criteria.evidence: src/cli/benchmark.zig emits hybrid_filter_vector_rank; tests/integration/benchmark_workload_acceptance.zig validates the benchmark metric contract; acceptance-smoke JSON count check validated hybrid_filter_vector_rank count 512.
criteria.notes: The workload combines tag filtering with vector distance ordering.

criteria.description: Add a persistence-facing checkpoint/reopen metric without corrupting durable state.
criteria.evidence: src/cli/benchmark_workloads.zig implements runPersistenceCheckpointReopen; tests/integration/benchmark_workload_acceptance.zig covers the workload; acceptance-smoke JSON count check validated persistence_checkpoint_reopen count 64.
criteria.notes: The smoke path creates, checkpoints, reopens, validates committed rows, and cleans the smoke file.

criteria.description: Preserve and validate existing Phase 6 concurrency benchmark metrics.
criteria.evidence: local-smoke text output included snapshot_begin, queued_commit, concurrent_read_write, checkpoint_overlap, and vector_overlay_visibility; tests/integration/benchmark_workload_acceptance.zig validates required Phase 6 metric names.
criteria.notes: Also covered by zig build test.

criteria.description: Add benchmark output tests for metric names, counts, dimensions, and JSON shape without fragile timing assertions.
criteria.evidence: tests/integration/benchmark_output_acceptance.zig and tests/integration/benchmark_workload_acceptance.zig validate JSON shape, metric names, counts, and allocation fields; zig build test passed.
criteria.notes: No absolute throughput or wall-clock thresholds are asserted.

criteria.description: Add warn-only baseline or threshold artifact for future CI gating.
criteria.evidence: docs/performance-baselines.json records schema_version 1, mode warn-only, hard_ci_gate false, expected preset counts, commands, and advisory warning deltas.
criteria.notes: Hard timing gates remain intentionally deferred.

criteria.description: Refresh roadmap and acceptance docs so Phase 8 status is honest.
criteria.evidence: docs/project-plan.md describes Phase 8 as in progress with stable presets, JSON output, allocation visibility, workload metrics, and warn-only baseline guidance; docs/acceptance-phase8-performance-discipline.md maps all FRs to evidence.
criteria.notes: The roadmap keeps hard timing gates deferred rather than overstating completion.

criteria.description: Existing SQL, transaction, persistence, vector, view/procedure, adapted fixture, and concurrency tests continue to pass.
criteria.evidence: zig build test passed on the integrated mission branch after WP01-WP05 were landed.
criteria.notes: This includes the benchmark integration suites added during Phase 8.
